ticker_news.title: Stocks Tumble, Nasdaq 100 Selloffs As Tech Giants Disappoint, Crypto Companies Plummet: What's Driving Markets Thursday?
ticker_news.description: Major tech companies like Microsoft and Meta disappointed investors, leading to a steep market selloff. Crypto-related stocks also plummeted, reflecting broader risk aversion in the markets.
ticker_news.author: Piero Cingari, Benzinga Staff Writer

ticker_news.title: Pixalate Releases Q3 2024 Malformed & Fraudulent CTV Bundle IDs Risk Report: $174 Million in Estimated Connected TV (CTV) Open Programmatic Ad Spend Went to Malformed, Unidentified, and/or Fraudulent Bundle IDs
ticker_news.description: Pixalate's analysis of over 2.2 billion open programmatic advertising impressions across CTV platforms found that a significant portion of Bundle IDs were malformed, unidentified, and/or fraudulent, disrupting ad targeting and campaign measurement.
ticker_news.author: Pixalate
